item.title: Zellij 0.46: built-in terminal, attention inbox, session previews
item.description: var playerElement = document.getElementById("player-wrapper"); var player = new Clappr.Player({ source: "/video/version-046-intro.mp4", mute: false, height: 540, width: 960 }); player.attachTo(playerElement); Zellij 0.46.0 has just been released! Check it out! Some highlights: Built-in Terminal (!!) Attention Inbox Session Previews Settings Screen Right-Click Menu and Improved Mouse Handling Theme Editor Distributions (run Zellij as a library) Horizontal Stacks Allow (temporarily) Hiding the UI What’s next? Please Support the Zellij Developer ❤️ Built-in Terminal Zellij has always been and will always be a terminal multiplexer first.
